messages.subject: Interpretation of Fixed Effects in Binomial Family
parts:
Hello INLA experts,

I have the below model which I am using but I am not sure how to interpret the fixed effects.  I have given the results also.

Are the fixed effects produced log of odds ?  How can I interpret the coefficients of covariates (bmi_pp, db_pp, sm_pp, ht_pp) in the below model?

formula2 =Counts ~ bmi_pp+db_pp+sm_pp+ht_pp+f(id,model="bym2",graph=g, scale.model =TRUE)

result3  =  inla(formula2,family="binomial",data=Final_data,Ntrials = Pop_counts,control.family = list(link = "logit"),control.predictor = list(compute=TRUE,link=1), control.inla = list(strategy = "adaptive"),control.compute=list(dic=TRUE), quantiles=c(0.025,0.975))
